title: Picture prompts describe visible things
summary: A picture request should describe the subject, setting and useful visual details. A model may miss a detail, so inspect the image afterward.
introduction: A picture request should describe the subject, setting and useful visual details. A model may miss a detail, so inspect the image afterward. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.text: A picture request should describe the subject, setting and useful visual details. A model may miss a detail, so inspect the image afterward.

blocks.code:
Subject: one paper boat
Setting: a shallow puddle after rain
Style: simple coloured-pencil drawing
Check: one boat, readable shape, no unwanted text
blocks.title: Picture prompts describe visible things

blocks.text: The plan names visible features that can be checked. It does not claim that an image has been generated.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Change the setting to a classroom desk while keeping the same boat.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Generated pictures can miscount objects or distort details; count and inspect them yourself.
